slides.head: Which company is bigger?
slides.body:
Share A costs ₦500.
Share B costs ₦5.

slides.head: Most people say A.
slides.body: But the share price alone can't tell you.

slides.head: Market cap = price × number of shares
slides.body: That's what the whole company is valued at on the market.

slides.head: B is 10 times bigger.
slides.body: Price is the cost of one slice. Market cap is the size of the whole cake.

slides.head: Know the stock before you buy the story.
